event: 43 Copa del Rey MAPFRE - ORC European Championship
facts: The request was lodged on July 30th at 08:45.
The request refers to an incident in the racing area that happened around 13:00 on July 29th.
The protest time limit for July 29th was 17:10.
Katara lodged a request for redress on July 29th for the same situation, and was a party to the hearing that discussed it.
conclusions: Katara failed to deliver the request for redress within the protest time limit, as required by RRS 61.2(b)(1). There was no good reason for the jury to extend the time.
